messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] R Group Restarting
messages.body_plain:
Sorry for the short notice (Once again my life is running far behind schedule).

We will start the R group up again, tomorrow, Sept 16 running from 12--1:30.

We have Stone Building 3203 if you would like to meet face-to-face, and

Russell Almond's Zoom Room, https://fsu.zoom.us/my/ralmond will be where you can join online.


If you no longer want to get thes announcements, you can cancel your subscription at the listserve at

https://lists.fsu.edu/mailman/listinfo/epls-r-users

There is also a canvas site for the user group.  You can self-enroll at

https://canvas.fsu.edu/enroll/AWFYCW.

Recordings generally get posted to the canvas site after they are done.

    --Russell
